name: The Games
desc:
This is where legends are born. This is where history is made.

Fierce challenges, heated rivalries, and epic showdowns. The path to ultimate victory is paved with determination and perseverance. Select your team and compete together in the legendary Kaelodrome to secure the championship win and so much more. Get in The Games.

👕 Join 1 of 5 elite influencer-led teams 
🪙 Complete quests to earn Silver          
💎 Unlock exclusive items
🏆 Compete to bring glory to your team


FAQ

Redemption 
Once you’ve discovered items and completed quests to earn badges, return to this experience to receive Shines and Silver to unlock your items.  

Platforms
The Games hub is available on mobile, PC, console, and VR. Some experiences may only be available on certain platforms. 

More FAQs: https://roblox.com/the-games
